name: start_rolling_release
description:
Start a rolling release for a deployment. If a rolling release is already active for the same canary deployment, returns the current state without side effects.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/start --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

canaryDeploymentId.description: The ID of the canary deployment to start the rolling release for

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
